entries.title: Hold the nine; fresh Lamar participation and a priced TE challenge
entries.question: Does new availability change the allocation, and can reducing Jets target competition justify a TE funding move?
entries.why_it_matters: The cheap Jets pairing and QB return assumptions can fail together; a TE upgrade has costs elsewhere.
findings: Official 554-row export still contains the same eleven Sunday afternoon games and selected IDs, positions and salaries; total $49,200/$800 remaining.

Ravens primary report: Lamar Jackson full Wednesday, after limited participation last week; positive return evidence, not confirmed Sunday start/effectiveness. Hamilton and Smith DNP introduce defensive uncertainty.

Current Jets–Raiders Wednesday report lists Braelon ankle LP and Hall quad LP. Neither Cooper nor Taylor is listed; absence is not final game clearance. Edge Bailey/Ossai DNP and Sweat DNP add Jets DST risk; Raiders Bowers LP is not OUT.
Official Lions Wednesday report confirms StBrown ankle NP and Gibbs shoulder NP; Williams is not listed. Do not turn absences into an invented Williams target or point boost.

Lions notebook describes MIN's 71% blitz rate and top scoring defense, alongside Goff's strong passing results against blitz. Attributed team-published statistics, not a guarantee of either pressure failure or Williams production.

TB current ATL report lists Gainwell hip DNP, Goedeke calf DNP and Mayfield thumb FP. Irving workload could rise if Gainwell misses, but blocking/efficiency may suffer; no absence assumed. Browns current PIT report has two OL DNP; Concepcion is not listed. Bengals page does not expose a reliable own-team report.
External TE article recommends Hockenson and Henry; reported shares/route rates remain attributed, not independently verified. Official salaries are $4,600 and $4,300 versus Taylor $3,300.
Current projection caption still covers fourteen Thu–Mon games, dated Oct28 23:06EDT for DK; no complete compatible Sunday nine estimates imported.

Week7 schedule remains final and inspected Jets box agrees with relevant retained inputs. No material correction or settled DraftKings evidence established; prior Week6/7 provisional reconstructed totals retained.
entries.interpretation: Retain current nine. Lamar full practice reduces one availability uncertainty, not effectiveness uncertainty. StBrown missed practice is now confirmed but not a forecast uplift. Do not fund a preferred TE by silently worsening another role.
alternatives: Taylor-only swap adds $1,300; $50,500 is over cap by $500. Requires a second funding move, not a legal standalone alternative.
Taylor-only swap adds $1,000; $50,200 is over cap by $200. Requires funding; article's receiving-role case merits future check.

Replace Taylor/Cooper ($8,100) with Hockenson/Mitchell ($8,600): total $49,700/$300 left, all other seven unchanged. Fits slots and export. Removes Jets TE overlap but downgrades Cooper to Mitchell; prior attributed routes70%vs55% and prior box3targets/0catches for Mitchell do not establish an upgrade. Hockenson-specific usage and Detroit matchup mechanism not independently resolved.
